# aibox

> Reproducible AI workspaces from one aibox.toml.

Version: v0.x current

## Change log

aibox release history.

- [v0.33.2 — runtime and processkit alignment](https://projectious-work.github.io/aibox/v0.x/v0.34.0/changelog/release-v0-33-2/): Refreshes processkit and runtime metadata while reconciling tmux layout and theme switching work.
- [v0.33.0 — agent-aware terminal titles](https://projectious-work.github.io/aibox/v0.x/v0.34.0/changelog/release-v0-33-0/): Adds configurable, terminal-neutral tmux titles and lifecycle attention signals for agent panes.
- [v0.33.1 — resilient runtime projections](https://projectious-work.github.io/aibox/v0.x/v0.34.0/changelog/release-v0-33-1/): Repairs generated harness startup, Yazi directory previews, and PowerKit window-tab spacing.

## Features

What aibox provides.


## Roadmap

The public aibox delivery roadmap.

- [v0.x](https://projectious-work.github.io/aibox/v0.x/v0.34.0/roadmap/v0/): Mature the current aibox line around dependable containers, addons, agent context, runtime diagnostics, and processkit integration.
- [v1.x](https://projectious-work.github.io/aibox/v0.x/v0.34.0/roadmap/v1/): Develop the next project-contract architecture while preserving reproducible, provider-neutral workspaces.
